title: Report Quality Overhaul — Professional Formatting, Prose Narrative, and Deduplication
goal: Fix the report output so it reads like a professional penetration test report rather than a raw data dump — eliminating Python dict output, adding narrative prose, deduplicating findings, and adding a professional header and risk gauge.
scope: Six specific fixes across all report variants: (1) ELIMINATE PYTHON DICT OUTPUT: Every field currently rendered as a Python dict must be reformatted. 'Findings by Severity: {medium: 12, low: 10}' becomes a formatted table or plain text. Target inputs as a clean bulleted list. Safety settings as human-readable key/value pairs. Configuration JSON must never appear as raw Python repr in any report. (2) EXECUTIVE NARRATIVE PARAGRAPH: The executive report must open with a 2-4 sentence AI-generated (or deterministic template) prose summary: 'This assessment of [target] conducted on [date] identified [N] vulnerabilities across [severity breakdown]. The most critical finding is [top finding]. Immediate remediation is recommended for [N] high/critical items.' When AI is enabled, this is generated by the AI provider. When disabled, a deterministic template fills in the values. (3) FINDING DEDUPLICATION: Group identical finding titles under one entry with a count and list of affected targets, rather than repeating the same finding N times. 'Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens (4 instances) — /login, /profile, /transfer, /settings'. (4) RISK SCORE DISPLAY: Show the exposure score prominently at the top of the executive report as a visual bar: 'Risk Level: MEDIUM (5.2/10) ████████░░░░'. (5) REMEDIATION PRIORITY TABLE: Top 5 findings in a prioritised table with columns: Priority, Finding, Severity, Effort, Impact. This is the first thing a developer reads. (6) PROFESSIONAL HEADER: Every report begins with: Assessment title, Target, Date range, Authorised by (from run configuration), Run ID (short), AegisPT version, Methodology version. Footer on every page/section: 'This report was generated by AegisPT. It is not a certification or attestation.'
generation_reason: Visual inspection of actual report output shows Python dicts rendered as literal text ({'medium': 12, 'low': 10}), the same finding repeated 4 times in the executive report, and no prose narrative. A client or auditor receiving this report would not take it seriously. Report quality is a direct commercial blocker — it is the final deliverable that justifies the assessment cost.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Report formatting and content quality only. No new finding schema fields. No new API endpoints. AI narrative is optional and falls back to deterministic template when provider is disabled.

success_criteria: No Python dict output appears in any report variant.
Executive report opens with a prose narrative paragraph.
Identical findings are grouped with instance count and target list.
Risk score appears as a visual bar at the top of the executive report.
Top 5 remediation priorities appear as a prioritised table.
Every report has a professional header with date, target, authorisation reference, and run ID.
Every report has a footer disclaimer.
Tests verify no Python repr in report output.

acceptance_criteria: No Python dicts in report output.
